newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Int'l Paper raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Int'l Paper raised to buy.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said it raised its rating on International Paper Co to buy from market performer.
-- set a 12-month price target of $52 a share.
-- said the very near-term outlook for paper sector remains soft. Sees favorable upward bias in most major grades over 12-month horizon.
-- raised 1997 earnings estimates to $2.25 a share from $1.85 a share. Set 1998 earnings estimate at $3.60 a share.
-- International Paper lost 1/2 to 42-3/8 in morning trading.
